trust_decision.summary: No trust decision exists in the linked fix: it only passes a non-null RowType into the KafkaSyncConverter/KafkaSyncKeyConverter constructors instead of null (which hits checkNotNull/NPE in AbstractRowConverter). No deserialization filter, type allow-list or depth limit is added or changed. The fix commit does not match the advisory's CWE-502 / stack-overflow description.

landing_point.why: Someone reading 'stack overflow / DoS, CWE-502' in a Kafka connector would start with the message decoder that turns untrusted Kafka record values into Maps via JsonUtil.toObject. The published fix does not touch this file.

fix_sites.entry_point: Kafka sync job (JSON job config, kafkasource/kafkasink) via KafkaSinkFactory/KafkaSourceFactory
Kafka sync sink job via KafkaSinkFactory

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the fix closes no security flaw, so there is no protection a solver could argue out of scope.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Unbounded-depth JSON parse of untrusted Kafka message values into Map.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Generic decoder shared by connectors. A maintainer would not think to cap nesting depth. Resource exhaustion, though, has never produced a hard task (0 of 7).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: fastjson JSON.parseObject on column string data.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: fastjson is used for column conversion. A polymorphic/autotype variant would be a plausible maintainer slip, but none exists here at the pinned commit.

O9_family: functional bug (null constructor argument / NPE) mislabelled as CWE-502 deserialization

O10_build.project_tests: unknown for KafkaSyncConverter; chunjun-core/src/test/java/com/dtstack/chunjun/decoder/JsonDecoderTest.java exists for the decoder

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pass a RowType built from kafkaConfig.getColumn() into the converter constructors. This is the published fix, and it has no security content.

out_of_scope_notes: Advisory-to-commit mapping looks wrong: commit #1966 is a follow-up to #1960/#1961 (constructor parameter fix), not a deserialization or stack-overflow fix.
The project uses fastjson JSONObject.parseObject in chunjun-restore-mysql transformers (DDLRowDataTransformer.java:34). This was not pursued.
